office_does: The treasurer collects property taxes and manages the county's money and banking, including for school, fire, water and cemetery districts.
race_blurb: Uncontested: Arny Davis (Prefers Republican Party), treasurer since 2015, is the only candidate.

candidates.summary: Lewis County Treasurer since 2015, former chief deputy treasurer and commercial lender; the only candidate on the ballot.
highlights: Treasurer since January 2015; chief deputy treasurer before that [S2]
More than 30 years in business management, finance and banking [S1][S2]
Statement stresses efficient financial operations and staff [S1]
